title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 28: Hananiah's promise of two full years, the broken bar of wood, and the bars of iron in its place.

questions.text: Which prophet spoke to Jeremiah in Yahweh's house, in the presence of the priests and all the people?
questions.explanation: Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to him in Yahweh's house in the presence of the priests and of all the people.

answers.text: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah
Hananiah the son of Azzur, of Gibeon
Uriah the son of Shemaiah

questions.text: In which year and month of Zedekiah's reign did this happen?
questions.explanation: It happened in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month.

answers.text: In the fourth year, in the fifth month
In the first year, in the first month
In the fifth year, in the fourth month
In the seventh year, in the second month

questions.text: What did Hananiah say that Yahweh of Armies had said?
questions.explanation: Hananiah said, "Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, 'I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.' "

answers.text: That the city would become a desolation
That the nations must serve Babylon seventy years
That the sword and the famine were at the gates
That He had broken the yoke of the king of Babylon

questions.text: Within what time did Hananiah say the vessels of Yahweh's house would be brought back?
questions.explanation: Hananiah said, "Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place."

answers.text: Within seven years
Within two full years
Within three months
Within seventy years

questions.text: Whom else did Hananiah say Yahweh would bring back to this place?
questions.explanation: Hananiah said Yahweh would bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah who went to Babylon.

answers.text: Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah and his servants
Only the craftsmen and the smiths of Jerusalem
Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, with all the captives of Judah
Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah

questions.text: How did the prophet Jeremiah first answer Hananiah's words?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said, "Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh's house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place."

answers.text: "Amen! May Yahweh do so."
"Yahweh of Armies has sent you."
He said nothing at all and left
"Go and tell this to the king of Judah."

questions.text: What did Jeremiah say about the prophet who prophesies of peace?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.

answers.text: That he must be put in the stocks
That he speaks only out of his own heart
That he should be believed at once
That he will be known when his word happens

questions.text: What did Hananiah do with the bar that was on Jeremiah's neck?
questions.explanation: Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck and broke it.

answers.text: He carried it to the king's house
He took it off and broke it
He put it on his own neck
He burned it with fire

questions.text: What word did Yahweh tell Jeremiah to bring to Hananiah about the bars?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron," and that He had put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to serve Nebuchadnezzar.

answers.text: That he had broken bars of wood, but made bars of iron in their place
That the bars would be restored to Jeremiah's neck
That all the nations were now free of the yoke
That he should go and make new bars of wood

questions.text: What did Jeremiah say would happen to Hananiah, and what does the chapter record?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said Yahweh would send him away from off the surface of the earth and that he would die that year, because he had spoken rebellion against Yahweh; and Hananiah died the same year, in the seventh month.

answers.text: That he would be taken captive, and he was carried to Babylon
That he would be struck dumb, and he spoke no more
That he would lose his office, and another took his place
That he would die that year, and he died in the seventh month
